pages.title: Catalogue
pages.content: The full catalogue by trade: trousers, jackets, aprons, coveralls and boots, with fabric, weight and price.

pages.title: Fabrics & specs
pages.content: Cotton duck, waxed cotton, twill, poly-cotton, soft-shell and full-grain leather.

pages.title: Fit & sizing
pages.content: Sizes XS–4XL, leg lengths 30 / 32 / 34 / 36, and a women's cut XS–2XL.

pages.title: Repairs & re-proofing
pages.content: Hemming, embroidery, re-proofing, zip and seam repairs and boot resoling.

pages.title: Crew orders
pages.content: 10% off crew orders of 10 garments or more. Sample kit in 5 working days.

pages.title: Crew stories
pages.content: Vos Joinery, Canal House Kitchen and Westpark Grounds Team.
